From day one, you'll be involved in real projects, helping to co\-ordinate multidisciplinary design teams, develop technical drawings and 3D models, and support project and design management activities. You'll have opportunities to engage with clients, contractors and stakeholders, building the communication and collaboration skills that are essential to successful project delivery. Through exposure to every stage of the design process, you'll rapidly develop your technical, commercial and professional capabilities while contributing to projects that improve connectivity for communities across the country. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story. description: **Pfizer Grange Castle Graduate Programme 2026** **Applications Open:** 21 September 2026 **Applications Close:** 18 October 2026 **Programme Start Date:** September 2027 Pfizer Grange Castle (Dublin) are delighted to be accepting applications for our 2027 Gradate Rotation Programme. Applications are open to students who are studying related areas in Science, Biotech and / or Engineering disciplines. Pfizer Grange Castle, located in Dublin, is one of Pfizer’s largest biopharmaceutical manufacturing sites and plays a key role in producing medicines and vaccines for patients around the world. The site specializes in biotechnology manufacturing, including the production of complex biologic medicines, and offers graduates the opportunity to work in a highly technical, innovative, and global environment. Our Graduate program offers students the chance to partake in a 23\-month rotational program in the Pfizer, Grange Castle site.We are offering a fantastic training and development opportunity to committed students who are excited about a potential career in biopharma. Exclusions may apply, eligible roles only. *Please note, any salary estimates given on third\-party sites are not provided or endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.* **Why Boots?** At Boots, we foster a working environment where consideration and inclusivity help everyone to be themselves and reach their full potential. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, passionate about embracing the diversity of our colleagues and providing a positive and inclusive working environment for all. As the heart of everything we do at Boots, with you, we change for the better. **What's next?** If this sounds like the perfect role for you, we look forward to receiving your application. title: Business & Digital Banking Graduate Programmes 2027
description: PTSB is one of Ireland's leading retail and SME banks, with an innovative range of products and services powered through an evolving digital landscape, our focus is centred on ensuring we deliver what our customers, colleagues and communities need to be successful. The PTSB Business \& Digital Banking Graduate Programmes are a 24\-month development programme offering graduates the opportunity to build their career through one of three specialist streams: Agricultural Banking, Asset Finance or Digital Channels. Through structured rotations, hands\-on experience and exposure to key areas of the business, graduates will develop expertise in customer relationship management, lending and credit, commercial decision\-making, digital innovation and business growth. Supported by experienced colleagues, assigned buddies and a comprehensive learning and development framework, graduates will gain the skills, experience and professional networks needed to build a successful long\-term career at PTSB. **Agricultural Retail Banking Graduate Programme** Support Ireland's farming and agribusiness communities through exposure to business banking, commercial lending, credit analysis and relationship management. **Asset Finance Retail Banking Graduate Programme** Develop expertise in Asset finance solutions, customer acquisition, fulfilment, customer service and commercial growth across the full asset finance lifecycle. **Digital Channels Retail Banking Graduate Programme** Help shape the future of digital banking by enhancing customer journeys, delivering digital innovation and supporting technology\-enabled change. Full details of each graduate stream, including rotations, responsibilities and requirements, are available within the individual role profiles. **Responsibilities:** As a Graduate in PTSB you can expect to perform some of the following activities: * Gain exposure and contribute to business\-critical projects in a fast\-paced environment, build strong management, interpersonal and technical skills throughout the Programme. * Adopt a continuous improvement mindset to identify customer pain points and process enhancements. * Due to the changing nature of work and rotations, we encourage flexibility amongst graduates to perform other ad hoc activities and seize new opportunities as they arise. * Establish and maintain professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders. * Engage with all areas of the organisation supporting colleagues and Bank wide initiatives. **Requirements:** * Graduating in 2027/ Graduated in 2026 * You must be legally entitled to work in the Republic of Ireland without restriction\*\*\* for the duration of the programme (September 2027 \- September 2029\) * \*\*\*Without restriction refers to candidates who have a valid visa in place and do not require any sponsorship (from company or self\-sponsorship) of work visa from September 2027 \- September 2029\. * Candidates must have or be on track to achieve a minimum result of a 2:1 Second Class Honours, Grade 1 (60 \- 69%) in their Level 8 qualification or above **This is a 24\-month fixed term contract based in St. Stephen's Green or Cork Airport Business Park (Hybrid Options available within Republic of Ireland only)** **Is this you?** Please apply online on our website or via the apply link of this role. Your application will be sent through to our Talent Acquisition team and they will be in touch regarding your application. We reserve the right to draw up a shortlist for interview. The Bank understands the importance of a consistent and relentless focus on championing diversity and inclusion. We aim to attract, recruit, and retain individuals with diverse backgrounds, skills, competencies and abilities to work collaboratively to enhance the service we provide to all of our customers and the communities we serve.

title: Civil / Structural Designer – BIM

Your impact The Advanced Manufacturing team in Ireland is seeking a **Civil/Structural Designer with strong BIM** capability to support the delivery of large scale Advanced Manufacturing facility projects. **This is a site based role** , working directly on fast paced, high tech construction programmes for global technology clients. You will play a key role in coordinating civil and structural design, supporting construction activities, and ensuring BIM models accurately reflect design intent and real time site conditions. The ideal candidate brings strong technical engineering knowledge, hands on site experience, and confidence working within multidisciplinary, BIM driven environments. **Role Overview** As a Civil/Structural Designer, you will support the full lifecycle of semiconductor facility delivery from design coordination and model development through to structural installation oversight, field engineering support, commissioning readiness and handover. You will work closely with construction teams, trade contractors, designers and client representatives to ensure civil and structural works are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards. You will be proficient in BIM coordination, structural engineering and site engineering within highly regulated cleanroom and advanced manufacturing environments. **Key Responsibilities** * Coordinate civil and structural engineering activities for assigned semiconductor project areas. * Develop, review and maintain BIM models, ensuring accuracy, clash resolution and alignment with design and construction requirements. * Support site installation of structural steel, concrete works, foundations, supports and associated civil infrastructure. * Conduct field inspections, verify installation quality and ensure compliance with specifications, codes and standards. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including mechanical, electrical, process, architectural and construction management. * Ensure adherence to high tech manufacturing, cleanroom and contamination control requirements where civil/structural interfaces apply. * Review technical submittals, method statements and contractor proposals. * Support commissioning and start up activities, including structural readiness, verification and documentation. * Maintain accurate project records, model updates and as built information. * Champion safety, quality and continuous improvement across all site activities. Here's what you'll need * Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline. * Strong experience delivering civil/structural works on large industrial or advanced manufacturing projects. * Proven capability in BIM tools such as Revit, Navisworks or equivalent. * Experience working site based on major construction programmes. * Knowledge of semiconductor facility requirements, high tech manufacturing environments or cleanroom related structural interfaces (advantageous). * Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams. * Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and BIM models. * Familiarity with construction quality standards, temporary works, and commissioning readiness \#NCAM26 \#NCSPG26 Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. title: Client Associate - SEO
description: **The Role** **Overview** The Core Search team sits within our Performance Practice and is responsible for managing and optimising search engine performance for our clients. We manage the strategy, planning, implementation, optimisation, reporting and analysis of search activity across Paid Search and SEO. Within the Search team, we have both Paid Search and SEO specialists working collaboratively to ensure some of Ireland’s leading brands achieve the best possible outcomes from their investment in search. The purpose of the SEO Client Associate role is to support the SEO team in the day\-to\-day delivery of effective SEO strategies for our clients. The role will provide hands\-on experience across technical SEO, content optimisation, keyword research, reporting and analysis, while building an understanding of how SEO contributes to wider client and business objectives. The role will also work collaboratively with other Practices across Core to help create integrated campaigns and solutions that deliver real results for our clients. This role requires someone who is analytical, curious and highly organised, with excellent attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills, an interest in digital media and a willingness to learn will be critical to success. **Responsibilities / Key Performance Indicators** Central to this role is supporting SEO Client Managers and Senior SEO Managers in delivering high\-quality SEO / GEO work across a range of clients. With appropriate training and guidance, responsibilities will include: * Supporting keyword research and search demand analysis to inform SEO and content recommendations. * Assisting with technical SEO audits and implementation reviews. * Supporting on\-page SEO optimisation, including content, metadata and internal linking recommendations. * Learning to use SEO tools and platforms including Semrush, Moz, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog or equivalent. * Using Google Analytics, including GA4, and Google Search Console to analyse organic search performance and AI platform performance. * Supporting site speed and page performance analysis. * Assisting with local SEO optimisation, including Google Business Profile. * Developing an understanding of link acquisition and digital authority techniques. * Supporting the preparation of regular and ad hoc SEO reports. * Interpreting performance data and identifying insights and opportunities with guidance from senior team members. * Keeping up to date with developments and changes within SEO, GEO and the wider search and discovery landscape. * Supporting client servicing through meeting preparation, follow\-ups and delivery of agreed actions. * Working collaboratively with colleagues across SEO, Paid Search and the wider Core business. Success will be defined through the quality and accuracy of work delivered, development of SEO knowledge and capability, contribution to client performance and positive feedback through Core's performance and development processes. **PRACTICE PERFORMANCE** * Develop an understanding of SEO and GEO best practice through training and hands\-on experience. * Produce accurate analysis and reporting that helps identify actionable insights for clients. * Listen actively to understand client and stakeholder needs. * Build knowledge across technical SEO, content optimisation, analytics and digital authority. * Develop proficiency in the platforms and technology used by the SEO team. * Understand clients' businesses, objectives and KPIs and how SEO can contribute to them. * Know where to source reliable information and proactively develop knowledge of the industry. * Demonstrate excellent attention to detail across all areas of work. * Think creatively when identifying solutions to client and SEO / GEO challenges. * Keep abreast of developments in search behaviour, search engines, AI platforms and the wider industry. * Communicate clearly, concisely and professionally. **COMMERCIAL PERFORMANCE** * Deliver high\-quality work for clients through consistent quality\-control processes. * Produce accurate, well\-presented reports demonstrating excellent attention to detail. * Complete assigned client work within agreed timelines and flag potential issues or delays appropriately. * Work with SEO Client Managers and Senior SEO Managers to identify opportunities to add value to client activity. * Respond promptly to requests and effectively manage agreed priorities. * Ensure timesheets are completed accurately and on time each week. * Follow agreed team processes and proactively flag where support or escalation is required. **TALENT MANAGEMENT** * Commit to Core Learning programmes and relevant training to support ongoing development. * Take ownership of developing technical and strategic SEO / GEO knowledge. * Work closely with SEO Client Managers and Senior SEO Managers to identify personal development requirements. * Understand and actively engage with your career development plan, biannuals, monthly catch\-ups and goals. * Contribute positively to team culture and the wider working and learning environment. * Uphold Core's values through words and actions. * Proactively build relationships across the wider company. * Participate in knowledge sharing within the SEO team and across Core. Be open to feedback and demonstrate the ability to apply learning to future work. **Your profile** **Experience** No previous professional SEO / GEO experience is required, although an interest in SEO, search, Ai discovery, digital media and marketing is essential. The ideal candidate will demonstrate: * An interest in how search engines work and how people discover information online. * An analytical mindset and confidence working with data and numbers. * Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * An interest in developing knowledge of SEO / GEO tools and platforms. * An interest in analytics and measurement. Experience or familiarity with any of the following would be beneficial but is **not essential** : * Google Analytics / GA4\. * Google Search Console. * Semrush, Moz, Ahrefs or similar SEO platforms. * Screaming Frog or similar crawling tools. * WordPress or other content management systems. * Basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript. * Keyword research or content optimisation. * Digital marketing through study, internships, personal projects or previous employment. **PERSON SPECIFICATION** * Highly analytical and comfortable working with data. * Excellent attention to detail. * Curious and motivated to learn new skills quickly. * Demonstrates a genuine interest in SEO, GEO, search and digital media. * Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build positive relationships with colleagues across Core. * Good listener with the ability to understand stakeholder objectives and instructions. * Able to communicate clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing. * Organised and able to manage multiple tasks and priorities. * Responsive and reliable in completing agreed actions. * Able to think creatively and contribute ideas. * Understands the importance of processes and quality control. * Proactively seeks opportunities to develop knowledge and skills. * Knows when to ask for support or escalate an issue. * Demonstrates a positive, collaborative approach to working as part of a team. **Why us?** **Why us?** * Work your way – Flexible, hybrid working that gives you the freedom to do your best work while fitting around your life. * Keep growing – Invest in your development with 24/7 internal learning programme access, structured mentoring and clear opportunities to progress your career. * Work that keeps things interesting – Partner with leading brands across sport, retail, food \& drink, alcohol, insurance, banking and many more, with no two days the same. * Time to switch off – Enjoy 21 days' annual leave with an additional increment with your time with us. Separate to this celebrate your birthday off, Christmas closure days and early finishes before bank holiday weekends. * A culture that supports balance – We genuinely value work–life balance and encourage you to take the time you need to perform at your best. * Support for every stage of life – From enhanced maternity and paternity leave \& other family leaves, to fertility support, phased returns, we're here for life's important moments. * Your wellbeing matters – Access mental health and wellbeing support, plus paid private health insurance for you and your dependants under 18, an Employee Assistance Programme, annual wellness contributions, free flu vaccinations, wellness events, fresh fruit, subsidised massages and more. * Plan ahead with confidence – Benefit from a contributory pension, life assurance cover and access to professional financial advice. * Make an impact beyond your role – Join our Diversity \& Inclusion, CSR, Green, Social or Great Place to Work committees and even earn an extra day's annual leave for your contribution. * Join an award\-winning workplace – Proudly recognised as a Great Place to Work® Certified organisation, ranked 4th in the Great Place to Work® Best Large Workplaces, and awarded Gold accreditation for our commitment to creating an exceptional employee experience. * A genuinely inclusive culture – Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion isn't just a policy here; it's part of who we are. Through our dedicated D\&I initiatives, employee networks and inclusive policies, we strive to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered. * We know how to have fun – From summer and Christmas parties to team socials, fundraising activities, birthday celebrations and company\-wide events, we make time to celebrate our people. **And that's just the start...** ****OUR COMMITMENTS** Our industry relies on creativity and innovation – these are skills that are not bound by gender, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, membership of the Traveller community, marital or family status, disability, age, socio\-economic background, or any other attributes. Core is committed to diversity in its workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants. If you need reasonable accommodation for any reason at any part of the interview process, please contact us and let us know the nature of your request and we will do our best to help.** **Salary Range** 30\.000 \- 31\.000 DOE **About Us** Core is Ireland's largest marketing communications company with over 400 people working across the key areas of marketing communications \- research, data science, strategy, planning, creative development and implementation. We are now a collective of nine practices, working towards a single purpose \- to expand the possibilities of what brands can achieve. At Core, we believe that change can move us forward and compel us towards new possibilities. Our wonderful people are at the centre of our success. It is essential that we keep building a high\-trust working environment that supports our people and enables them to flourish. There is no magic formula for becoming a great place to work. Instead, it involves working together, through constant change, to match the personal dreams and ambitions of our people with the aspirations of the organisation. Over the years, we have cemented our position as a great place to work, with 2026 being voted 4th Best Large Workplace in Ireland. Additionally, we are recognised as a Best Workplace for Women, and Best Workplace for Health \& Wellbeing. 2026 is our best year yet, and we're excited to have you join us and our continued success.

title: Communications and Operations Coordinator
description: **Job title:** Vision Sports Ireland Communications \& Operations Coordinator **Location:** Vision Ireland Head Office, Drumcondra, Co Dublin (Hybrid option available) **Vacancy Type:** Full time and permanent **Working schedule:** Monday to Friday **Closing date:** 5th October 2026 **About Vision Sport Ireland** Vision Sports Ireland (VSI) is the national governing body for sport and physical activity for people who are blind and vision impaired in Ireland. As a subsidiary of Vision Ireland, a national sight loss charity, we work to ensure that everyone with a vision impairment \- regardless of ability has the opportunity to participate in sport and physical activity. Our organisational strategy, *Beyond Vision 2025\-2028* , sets out an ambitious vision: to create a society where blind and visionimpaired people can access sport and physical activity wherever and whenever they choose. Be part of a growing organisation leading the development of inclusive sport and physical activity opportunities for people who are blind and vision impaired across Ireland **The Role** The **Communications \& Operations Coordinator** will play a key role in leading the marketing and communications strategy for VSI. They will play an instrumental part of the operations team with responsibility for amplifying the importance of sport and physical activity for people who are blind and vision impaired as well as the array of programme offerings provided by VSI. The successful candidate will collaborate with key stakeholders including National Governing Bodies for Sport to coordinate programmes and highlight achievements of VSI members. Increasing awareness of the health promotion and education offerings will be a key objective to meet actions set out in our strategic plan. The successful candidate will work closely with the National Sports Development Manager and members of the wider team to build the Vision Sports Ireland brand, promote programmes, initiatives, and partnerships. This candidate should be a highly motivated, creative and innovative professional. The appointee will be responsible for managing social media and website content which have become an integral part of the organisations growth. **Key Responsibilities** Position Vision Sports Ireland as the experts in vision impairment in the field of sport and physical activity. Provide key input into day\-to\-day operations of the organisation. Lead on the execution of a comprehensive marketing and communications plan to promote Vision Sports Ireland services and activities. Increasing engagement and reach of the organisation's online profile by curating relevant social media content reflecting Vision Sports Irelands activities and that of our partners. The role will have responsibility for the VSI website and social media platforms along with creating engaging content that increases awareness of the work of Vision Sports Ireland Working collaboratively with partner organisations to strategically cross\-promote activities. Work closely with Vision Ireland colleagues to embed physical activity as a core programme offering within the wider service. Work closely with the Vison Sports Ireland team to increase participation numbers in programmes and initiatives. Monitoring and evaluation of platform analytics. Coordinate activities and events in collaboration with NGB Partners. Work as part of a motivated and focused team to service the priorities of Vision Sports Ireland. Monitoring, updating and evaluation of website and social media analytics, e\-newsletter. Work as part of a team for programme coordination and event management. Work to develop innovative ways to promote programmes and events. Continually evaluate and monitor the quality of services provided by Vision Sports Ireland. Work as part of a team to drive and advance coach education, volunteerism and training opportunities. Serve and support colleagues as a member of the Vision Sports Ireland Team including, but not limited to, funding applications and reporting obligations. Contribute to funding, sponsorship activities related to Vision Sports Ireland. **Skills, Qualifications And Experience** The ideal candidate will hold a third level qualification in marketing/communications, digital content creation, business management, recreation and leisure management or an equivalent. Proven track record in delivering a communications strategy including report writing. Experience of creating campaigns for a start\-up or large organisation. Knowledge of the importance of physical activity, sport, community initiatives, and inclusive participation. You'll work closely with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders to support the management of strategic supplier contracts, ensure governance processes are followed, and provide valuable reporting and analysis to support business decisions. A fast\-growing company with a long history of training and developing people in both sales and managerial roles, Edmundson are now seeking to continue their success by adding entry level talent into their teams. **The Role** Edmundson Electrical are looking to recruit, train and develop ambitious graduates to be based out of any of their 400 independently run profit centres across the UK and Ireland. description: **The Vacancy** **About The Company** At Nicholas O'Dwyer, sustainability is at the core of our work. If you are looking to advance your career in a socially responsible company, which has a proven track record over 90 years, and is committed to creating a sustainable planet, we invite you to be part of our team. Our mission is to provide innovative and reliable solutions using cutting edge technology and expertise, to ensure project success and employee satisfaction. This is an exciting opportunity for a recent graduate to kick\-start their career in civil or environmental engineering, working on a diverse range of water infrastructure projects. As part of the team, you will gain invaluable hands\-on experience, develop your technical and project management skills, and work on projects that positively impact communities and the environment. You will have the opportunity to contribute to all phases of water engineering projects, from feasibility studies to detailed design and construction, while learning from experienced engineers in a collaborative and supportive environment. You will structured training and mentoring throughout your first year. In addition to office\-based learning and development, you will have practical exposure through site visits and involvement in site\-based activities. **Key Duties And Responsibilities** * Building your knowledge of water engineering principles, regulations, and best practices. * Preparation of Feasibility, Route, and Site Selection Reports. * Contributing to the preparation of Concept and Detailed Design Reports, including drawings, calculations, and specifications. * Clean water network modelling with various modelling software in design and analysis. * Contributing to the preparation of Technical Specifications and Contract Documents for work and investigations. * Assisting in the preparation of documentation for statutory approvals, such as planning permissions and wayleaves. * Collaborate with senior engineers and project managers during construction stage contract administration. * Gaining exposure to developing detailed project plans, including budgets, schedules, and resource allocation. * Assisting in ensuring projects are delivered within budget, on time, and in compliance with regulations and standards. * Learning to identify and mitigate project risks under guidance from senior team members. * Fostering effective communication and collaboration within the team, clients, and stakeholders. * Ensuring all work adheres to Health \& Safety legislation and quality management systems. * Undertake additional responsibilities as required, in line with the evolving needs of the role and the business. * Opportunities to visit sites across Ireland/UK. **Key Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering or a related discipline (or currently completing). * Interest in and basic understanding of water engineering principles and practices. * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative team and build positive working relationships. * Methodical, detail\-oriented approach to problem\-solving, with curiosity, a willingness to ask questions, and an eagerness to learn through mentorship. * Self\-motivated and dependable, able to take initiative on assigned tasks while contributing positively within a supportive team environment. * Familiarity with design software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GIS (ArcGIS \& QGIS) or similar tools is advantageous but not essential. * Familiarity with hydraulic modelling software such as Epanet, Synergi, MicroDrainage, HEC\-RAS or similar tools is advantageous but not essential. * Possession of a valid Irish driving license would be advantageous for site visits and project\-related travel. **About Us** Our mission is to deliver sustainable solutions that transform communities and bring about lasting positive change. Through a blend of expertise, innovation and global dedication, we envision a world where sustainable engineering protects growing communities. Nicholas O’Dwyer provides professional services in engineering design, project management, environment and planning, construction supervision and technical and contract advisory. We are one of the most respected Irish consultancies operating in local and international markets, providing professional services to public\- and private\-sector clients. Whether in Ireland, the UK or internationally, we understand and solve major challenges associated with delivering and adapting infrastructure for an increasing global population while maintaining a sustainable environment for future generations. Nicholas O’Dwyer is part of the RSK Group, a leading integrated environmental, engineering, and technical services business providing dynamic, multidisciplinary services to a wide range of sectors. RSK was founded in 1989 and has grown considerably since then. At RSK, we operate as a group of businesses that work together seamlessly, aiming for growth through diversification. Our strategy helps us build a strong and resilient business, capable of weathering external challenges, while also providing greater value to our clients and more opportunities for our employees. Since the beginning, our philosophy has remained the same: employ, develop and reward talented individuals. People are crucial to our company, and we recognise that our success hinges on our colleagues' growth. We're committed to preserving RSK's people\-first culture, promoting innovation, and fostering a supportive and caring environment for collaboration. At RSK, we want you to be part of our successes and help you reach your career aspirations. We take pride in offering employees fulfilling and challenging careers by promoting ongoing growth and empowering individuals to excel. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We firmly believe that embracing and celebrating the diversity in our workforce makes us a stronger and more innovative company. If you're passionate about making a difference, join us as we work together to build a brighter, more equitable, and sustainable future for all. Do you have what it takes?

title: Kubernetes Engineer
description: **Overview** We are seeking a Kubernetes Developer to join our global infrastructure and platform engineering team, helping build software\-driven automation for InterSystems Kubernetes\-based managed services and SaaS platforms. You will work with software engineers, Kubernetes architects, DevOps, SRE, and security teams to develop reliable, secure, production\-ready platform capabilities. The role combines Go development with hands\-on Kubernetes experience, with a focus on turning repeatable operational processes into maintainable platform software. Key Responsibilities * Develop and maintain Kubernetes\-native software in Go, including controllers, Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), reconciliation logic, and automation components. * Build automation for provisioning, configuration, upgrades, scaling, recovery, and other managed service workflows. * Write maintainable Go code and develop unit, integration, and cluster\-based tests. * Support CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, packaging, and releasing Kubernetes platform software. * Integrate with Kubernetes networking, storage, ingress, certificates, scheduling, security, and cluster lifecycle capabilities. * Contribute to automation using Helm, Terraform, GitOps, Argo CD, Flux, and related tooling. * Implement secure defaults, least\-privilege RBAC, secrets handling, workload isolation, and operational guardrails. * Build observable and supportable software using logs, metrics, events, health checks, and status conditions. * Troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads, controller behaviour, failed reconciliations, deployments, and automation issues. * Collaborate with engineering, SRE, security, and application teams, and contribute to documentation, runbooks, and knowledge sharing. **Experience \& Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, infrastructure automation, cloud engineering, or SRE. * Experience developing in Go, or strong software engineering experience with the ability to work in Go. * Practical experience with Kubernetes, containers, Linux, and cloud\-native deployment patterns. * Familiarity with Kubernetes APIs, CRDs, controllers, reconciliation loops, RBAC, events, status conditions, and resource lifecycle. * Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and code review. * Working knowledge of Helm, Terraform, GitOps, Argo CD, Flux, or similar tooling. * Understanding of Kubernetes security concepts including RBAC, secrets, namespaces, network policies, admission controls, and workload isolation. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills. Nice to Have * Experience with Kubebuilder, Operator SDK, controller\-runtime, client\-go, or similar frameworks. * Experience developing Kubernetes Operators, controllers, admission webhooks, or platform automation. * Experience with EKS, AKS, GKE, Rancher, Spectro Cloud, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Fluent Bit, ELK/EFK, Istio, Linkerd, Cilium, Velero, Kasten, or Stash. * Open\-source contributions to Kubernetes, Go, cloud\-native, or platform engineering projects. * Relevant certifications such as CKAD, CKA, CKS, Terraform Associate, or LFCS. **About InterSystems** InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next\-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit **InterSystems.com** . **AI Disclaimer** InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information). InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees. Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience. AI tools and third\-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments. Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI\-related tools or other technology\-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is *strictly prohibited* during the interview and screening process with InterSystems. Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department *prior* to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.

title: Orientation and Mobility Instructor
description: **Job Title:** Orientation and Mobility Instructor **Organisation** : Vision Ireland **Contract Type:** Full time, permanent **Work schedule:** Monday to Friday, office hours **Reporting to** : Learning Pathways Practise Lead \& Lifecycle Manager **Closing Date:** 5th October 2026 **Position Overview** Vision Ireland's **National Training Centre (NTC Dublin)** is seeking an **Orientation \& Mobility Instructor** to provide specialist assessment, training, and support for individuals with sight loss. This role focuses on equipping **working\-age adults** with the essential skills to **enhance independence, access employment or education, and improve overall quality of life** . As part of Vision Ireland's **Employment, Training \& Academia (ETA) team** , the instructor will develop and deliver personalised rehabilitation programmes, ensuring learners can confidently navigate daily life and work environments. This is a **permanent role** , offering an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a professional, supportive, and **learner\-centred** environment. **About The Role** * Assess the ability of clients to travel safely and confidently within area of the community they wish to access; * Advise on and prescribe a range of mobility aids and provide specialist services to meet individual needs; * Monitor and advise on the use of low vision aids as applicable to a mobility program; * In consultation with clients, plan, develop, deliver and evaluate individual or group specialised services in line with clients' needs identified throughout the assessment process. **Responsibilities** Orientation \& Mobility Assessment \& Individualised Planning * Conduct comprehensive functional O\&M assessments to identify the impact of vision loss on safe and independent travel. * Assess mobility within home, community, education, training and employment environments. * Develop and review individualised O\&M and rehabilitation plans based on assessed needs and personal goals. * Identify barriers to independence and agree appropriate training, interventions and onward referrals. Orientation \& Mobility Training * Deliver specialist O\&M training to promote safe, confident and independent travel. * Provide training in orientation, route planning, road crossing, public transport and environmental navigation. * Assess, prescribe and provide training in the safe use of mobility aids. * Introduce appropriate electronic travel aids, GPS and accessible navigation technologies. * Support learners to transfer O\&M skills to new and unfamiliar environments. * Advise on environmental accessibility and mobility\-related reasonable accommodations. QQI Programme Delivery \& Assessment * Deliver and assess the QQI Level 4 Specific Purpose Certificate in Orientation, Mobility \& Access (4S21459\). * Plan and deliver accessible, learner\-centred theory and practical O\&M training. * Develop appropriate lesson plans, learning resources and assessment activities. * Conduct practical assessments and provide constructive learner feedback. * Maintain complete and accurate learner, assessment and certification records. * Participate in internal verification, external authentication and results approval processes as required. * Ensure programme delivery and assessment comply with Vision Ireland QA procedures and QQI requirements. * Contribute to programme monitoring, review and continuous improvement. Wider Vision Rehabilitation * Provide practical rehabilitation training to promote independence in daily living and community participation. * Support learners to maximise functional/residual vision through appropriate strategies and adaptations. * Introduce relevant compensatory techniques, accessible formats and communication approaches. * Support the use of appropriate assistive technology, referring to specialist colleagues where required. * Integrate O\&M interventions with the learner's wider rehabilitation goals. Employment, Education \& Community Access * Support learners to develop the mobility and independence skills required to access employment, education and training. * Assess accessibility and mobility barriers within workplace and learning environments. * Advise on appropriate environmental adjustments and reasonable accommodations. * Work with employment and training colleagues to support learner progression and workplace readiness. Learner Support * Provide person\-centred support to learners adjusting to vision loss and developing new independence skills. * Promote confidence, choice, self\-advocacy and independence throughout the rehabilitation process. * Engage appropriately with families, carers and other supports, with the learner's involvement and consent. * Refer learners to additional Vision Ireland or external specialist services where required. Multidisciplinary \& Stakeholder Working * Work collaboratively within Vision Ireland's multidisciplinary rehabilitation, training and employment services. * Liaise with healthcare professionals, ETBs, employers and community services as appropriate. * Provide specialist O\&M input into individual support and progression planning. * Contribute to service development and initiatives that improve access, mobility and inclusion. title: Software Engineer (Mid-level)

title: Trainee Accountant
description: At Flipdish, we’re turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple\-to\-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that’s anything but. **About the role** You’ll join the Finance team at Flipdish, supporting a fast\-moving, multi\-entity environment where accurate financial information, strong controls, and clear reporting help the business make better decisions. This is a hands\-on trainee role with exposure across accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month\-end support, audit preparation, and reporting. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, building the foundations for a successful ACA / ACCA / CIMA training path while taking on more responsibility as you develop. This role follows our hub model, with a healthy blend of hub and home working: 2 days per week from our Sandyford office. **What you’ll own** * Support core AP and AR processes, including invoice processing, supplier and customer queries, payment support, reconciliations, and maintaining accurate finance records across multiple entities. * Assist with month\-end close, audit, tax, and statutory reporting requests by preparing journals, schedules, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and clear supporting documentation. * Investigate and resolve reconciling items, unusual balances, and transaction queries; work with Finance and wider business stakeholders to improve financial information and recurring processes. * Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility — prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility. **What success looks like** * You understand Flipdish’s finance processes, systems, month\-end timetable, and key stakeholders. * You are confidently supporting core AP and AR tasks with good accuracy, attention to detail, and clear supporting documentation. * You are preparing basic reconciliations and month\-end schedules with improving independence. * You are asking good questions, learning quickly, and escalating issues early when something does not look right. * You are identifying small process improvements or ways to make recurring tasks more efficient. **You’ll thrive in this role if you:** * Have a strong academic record, ideally with a degree in accounting, finance, business, economics, or a related discipline. * Are eager to commence, or have recently commenced, ACA / ACCA / CIMA. * Have strong numerical ability, attention to detail, and pride in producing accurate, well\-supported work. * Are highly organised, dependable, and able to follow through on tasks in a fast\-paced environment. * Communicate clearly, collaborate well with others, and are willing to ask questions. * Have good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets, with a willingness to keep improving quickly. * Take ownership of your work: you do not wait to be told what to do when you can spot the next useful step. **The following would help you stand out:** * Some finance, accounting, bookkeeping, internship, or office experience. * Exposure to accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month\-end, or financial reporting. * Experience working with finance systems, spreadsheets, or structured data. **What you get** We’re a growing startup and we understand that amazing incentives will attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you’re smart, ambitious, and hard\-working, we’ll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher! * **Hub model (hybrid):** a healthy blend of hub \+ home working (2 days per week from our Sandyford office) * **Time off:** 25 days annual leave \+ public holidays \+ company days (e.g. Summer Fridays, seasonal) * **Private healthcare:** IE cover (provided through Laya Healthcare) * **Pension:** Retirement savings support (IE) * **Equity (ESOP):** share options, so you can share in Flipdish’s long\-term success * **Team connection:** regular team meet\-ups and company events * **Commuter supports:** TaxSaver / travel schemes (where available) **Here’s what you can expect throughout the interview process.** 1. Recruiter screening call (15 minutes) 2. Hiring manager interview (60 minutes) 3. Competency / technical stage (60 minutes) 4. Reference checks **Our Culture** At Flipdish, we’re on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that’s powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support. Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We’re an AI\-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes, faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations, so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters. Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people\-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other, and create the space for people to grow (with balance, not burnout). We’re focused on impact and team energy, not “being seen”. You’ll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales. If you’d like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.

A partir de este mínimo, estamos interesados en conocer perfiles con diferentes niveles de experiencia, desde veterinarios que hayan adquirido sus primeros años de experiencia clínica hasta profesionales con una trayectoria más consolidada. **También Estamos Especialmente Interesados En** Veterinarios/as Senior Lead Vets Veterinarios/as con responsabilidades de liderazgo Profesionales con interés o experiencia en áreas clínicas específicas Veterinarios/as con formación especializada Diplomados Salarios orientativos Las condiciones varían según la clínica, experiencia, responsabilidades y especialización: 2–3 años de experiencia clínica: 45\.000 € – 50\.000 € 3–5 años de experiencia en pequeños animales: 50\.000 € – 65\.000 € Veterinarios/as Senior y Lead Vets: hasta 90\.000 € Veterinarios/as Diplomados y determinados perfiles especializados: más de 100\.000 € El salario final dependerá de la experiencia, competencias clínicas, especialización, responsabilidades y características de cada posición. ¿Qué ofrecen las oportunidades? **Dependiendo Del Puesto y Del Cliente** Contrato indefinido Salarios competitivos según experiencia Bonus de incorporación en determinadas posiciones Formación continua y CPD financiado Pago de las cuotas del Veterinary Council of Ireland (VCI) Seguro profesional Ayuda con el traslado y relocation a Irlanda Apoyo durante el proceso de incorporación Oportunidades de desarrollo y progresión profesional Diferentes tipos de clínicas y entornos de trabajo Posiciones en diferentes regiones de Irlanda ¿Nunca has trabajado en Irlanda? No es necesario tener experiencia profesional previa en Irlanda. Si estás pensando en trasladarte a Irlanda, podemos orientarte durante el proceso y facilitarte información sobre las oportunidades disponibles, el registro en el VCI, documentación, condiciones de trabajo y traslado. Valoramos cada perfil individualmente y buscamos oportunidades que se ajusten a la experiencia, intereses profesionales, expectativas y preferencias de cada veterinario/a. Diferentes oportunidades en Irlanda Trabajamos con diferentes clientes y recibimos nuevas posiciones de forma regular. Esto nos permite ofrecer oportunidades para veterinarios/as con distintos niveles de experiencia, desde profesionales con 2–3 años de experiencia clínica hasta veterinarios/as con una trayectoria más extensa, incluyendo posiciones Senior, Lead y especializadas. Si actualmente no tenemos una vacante que encaje exactamente con tu perfil, podemos mantener tus datos y contactar contigo cuando surja una oportunidad adecuada. Refer a Friend ¿Conoces a otro veterinario que esté pensando en trabajar en Irlanda? Recomiéndanos a un amigo o compañero. Si la persona recomendada consigue una colocación con éxito con uno de nuestros clientes, podrá beneficiarse de nuestro programa Refer a Friend. Más de 10 años de experiencia internacional Desde 2015 ayudamos a veterinarios europeos a encontrar oportunidades profesionales en Irlanda, Reino Unido y Alemania. Hemos ayudado a más de 100 veterinarios europeos a desarrollar su carrera profesional en el extranjero. ¿Quieres conocer las oportunidades disponibles? Si estás pensando en trabajar en Irlanda, envíanos tu CV en inglés. Valoraremos tu perfil y te informaremos sobre las oportunidades que mejor puedan encajar con tu experiencia, intereses y objetivos profesionales.
